require 'tempfile'
require 'fileutils'
require 'socket'
require 'thread'
require 'securerandom'
require 'digest'

module PgPooler
  class ConnectionPool
    POOL_SIZE = 10
    SOCKET_DIR = '/tmp/pgpooler'
    
    attr_reader :connections, :mutex
    
    def initialize(config = {})
      @config = {
        host: config[:host] || 'localhost',
        port: config[:port] || 5432,
        database: config[:database] || 'app_production',
        username: config[:username] || 'app',
        password: config[:password],
        pool_size: config[:pool_size] || POOL_SIZE,
        statement_cache_dir: config[:statement_cache_dir]
      }
      @connections = []
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @available = ConditionVariable.new
      @checked_out = []
      setup_cache_directory
    end

    def checkout
      @mutex.synchronize do
        loop do
          conn = find_available_connection
          return conn if conn
          
          if @connections.size < @config[:pool_size]
            conn = create_connection
            @checked_out << conn
            return conn
          end
          
          @available.wait(@mutex, 5)
        end
      end
    end

    def checkin(connection)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @checked_out.delete(connection)
        @available.signal
      end
    end

    def prepare_statement(conn, name, sql)
      cache_file = statement_cache_path(conn, name)
      
      if File.exist?(cache_file)
        cached = File.read(cache_file)
        return cached if valid_cached_plan?(cached, sql)
      end
      
      plan = compile_statement(conn, name, sql)
      persist_statement_cache(cache_file, plan)
      plan
    end

    def shutdown
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @connections.each { |c| c[:socket]&.close }
        @connections.clear
        cleanup_cache_directory
      end
    end

    private

    def setup_cache_directory
      @cache_dir = @config[:statement_cache_dir] || default_cache_dir
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@cache_dir, mode: 0700) unless Dir.exist?(@cache_dir)
    end

    def default_cache_dir
      base = ENV['PGPOOLER_CACHE'] || SOCKET_DIR
      File.join(base, "cache_#{Process.pid}")
    end

    def statement_cache_path(conn, statement_name)
      conn_id = conn[:id]
      sanitized_name = statement_name.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '_')
      File.join(@cache_dir, "#{conn_id}_#{sanitized_name}.plan")
    end

    def persist_statement_cache(path, plan_data)
      # Write to temp file first, then atomic rename
      dir = File.dirname(path)
      basename = File.basename(path)
      
      tmp = File.join(dir, ".#{basename}.#{Process.pid}.tmp")
      File.open(tmp, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::EXCL, 0600) do |f|
        f.write(plan_data)
        f.fsync
      end
      File.rename(tmp, path)
    end

    def create_connection
      conn_id = generate_connection_id
      socket = establish_socket_connection
      authenticate(socket)
      
      conn = {
        id: conn_id,
        socket: socket,
        created_at: Time.now,
        transaction_state: :idle,
        pid: retrieve_backend_pid(socket)
      }
      @connections << conn
      write_connection_pidfile(conn)
      conn
    end

    def generate_connection_id
      SecureRandom.hex(8)
    end

    def establish_socket_connection
      TCPSocket.new(@config[:host], @config[:port])
    rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED => e
      raise ConnectionError, "Cannot connect to #{@config[:host]}:#{@config[:port]}: #{e.message}"
    end

    def authenticate(socket)
      # Simplified auth handshake
      startup_msg = build_startup_message
      socket.write(startup_msg)
      response = socket.read(1)
      case response
      when 'R'
        handle_auth_response(socket)
      when 'E'
        raise AuthenticationError, "Authentication failed"
      end
    end

    def write_connection_pidfile(conn)
      pidfile_path = connection_pidfile_path(conn[:id])
      File.open(pidfile_path, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::EXCL, 0600) do |f|
        f.write("#{Process.pid}\n#{conn[:pid]}\n#{Time.now.to_i}")
      end
    rescue Errno::EEXIST
      # File already exists, regenerate with different id
      raise ConnectionError, "PID file collision detected, retry connection"
    end

    def connection_pidfile_path(conn_id)
      runtime_dir = ENV['XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'] || File.join(Dir.home, '.pgpooler')
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(runtime_dir, mode: 0700) unless Dir.exist?(runtime_dir)
      File.join(runtime_dir, "pgpooler_#{conn_id}.pid")
    end

    def find_available_connection
      available = @connections.find { |c| !@checked_out.include?(c) && connection_alive?(c) }
      if available
        @checked_out << available
        available
      end
    end

    def connection_alive?(conn)
      return false unless conn[:socket]
      !conn[:socket].closed?
    rescue
      false
    end

    def compile_statement(conn, name, sql)
      # Simulate prepared statement compilation
      "PLAN:#{name}:#{Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(sql)}:#{conn[:id]}"
    end

    def valid_cached_plan?(cached, sql)
      expected_hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(sql)
      # Parse the structured 'PLAN:name:hash:conn_id' format and compare the
      # hash field exactly, instead of a loose substring match that could be
      # satisfied by the hash appearing in an unrelated field.
      parts = cached.to_s.split(':')
      return false unless parts.length >= 4 && parts[0] == 'PLAN'
      actual_hash = parts[2]
      secure_compare(actual_hash, expected_hash)
    end

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      res = 0
      a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| res |= x ^ y }
      res == 0
    end

    def cleanup_cache_directory
      FileUtils.rm_rf(@cache_dir) if @cache_dir && Dir.exist?(@cache_dir)
    end

    def retrieve_backend_pid(socket)
      # Would normally parse from server response
      rand(1000..99999)
    end

    def build_startup_message
      # Simplified PostgreSQL startup message
      params = "user\x00#{@config[:username]}\x00database\x00#{@config[:database]}\x00\x00"
      version = [196608].pack('N')  # 3.0
      length = [4 + version.length + params.length].pack('N')
      length + version + params
    end

    def handle_auth_response(socket)
      # Read auth type
      len = socket.read(4)&.unpack1('N') || 0
      socket.read(len - 4) if len > 4
    end
  end

  class ConnectionError < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < StandardError; end
end
